how-to-speak-and-write-correctly: Lexicographer Joseph Devlin wrote this no-nonsense guide for anyone who wants to use English well. Grammar, punctuation, word choice, and common errors are explained in plain rules with plenty of examples. Though written a century ago, its practical advice still helps students, workers, and writers who want their words to be clear and correct.
the-history-of-mr-polly: H. G. Wells' beloved comic novel follows Mr. Polly — the timid draper who burns down his shop and runs away to freedom. His adventures at the Potwell Inn are pure delight. Wells' warmest and funniest book. A holiday, a fire, and a brave fight at the inn change his life forever.
the-adventures-of-sally: Wodehouse's Adventures of Sally — the red-haired American girl conquering England with high spirits — sparkles with his brightest comedy. Sally's escapades, suitors, and scrapes never flag for a page. Pure Wodehouse joy from start to finish. Fillmore, Ginger, and the whole theater crowd adore her.
the-newcomes-memoirs-of-a-most-respectab: Thackeray's Newcomes — the tale of a most respectable family — follows good Colonel Newcome and his son Clive through the ups and downs of Victorian town life. The old Colonel's plain, kind heart shines in this big, humane book. Ethel Newcome's pride and the Colonel's fall make reading no one forgets. Among Thackeray's best and most loved works.
